Hammer unions of different figure numbers must never be joined: the male half of a 602 or 1002 union can make up into a 1502 wing nut and look made up, then separate under pressure. Mismatched unions have caused fatalities and IADC recommends colour coding, go/no-go gauges and segregated storage.
NACE MR0175 / ISO 15156 sets material requirements for equipment used in H2S-containing oil and gas production.
